decided: LST-7 (#7489), per epic #7481's bounded set (alert channels and policies)
decision: Alert channels are configuration, not a ledger: each is a verified destination an org sets up once. The Channels list stays one filtered read (`alerts.channels` → `queryAlertChannelsPage`), rendered whole, with facets over the org's unfiltered channels and no count pill.
bound: `ALERT_CHANNELS_MAX` (50) in apps/console/lib/queries/alerts-lists.ts, enforced at create by `addChannel` (app/server/actions/alerts.ts) under a per-org transaction lock; the read never cuts at it.
